summary.text: Elizabeth Fiedler is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 184, which she has represented since December 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fiedler assumed office in the House on December 1, 2018, succeeding William Keller.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations (as subcommittee chair on Education), Environmental Resources & Energy, Finance, Health and Rules committees.
